summary: I've revised the plan. The data is good for the current design but mixed for earlier ones, so I'm proposing to show both. On the current design, Gate gets the same results as Opus alone for about half the cost. In half of the six earlier SWE-Bench Pro comparisons, Gate cost more than Opus.
